purpose: Public native GraphCoder JSON-lines qualification for exact tool approval, real staging, cancellation, and reopen

runtime.fixture_policy: Harness installs a deterministic policy that requires approval for acyclic.stage_file. The fixture provider emits the stage_file call, the approved operation performs the real Harness filesystem effect, and the provider then remains cancellable. No host side effect is implemented by the fixture.

assertions: the first model turn persists an exact pending approval before stage_file executes
a forged approval identity returns not_found and an incorrect operator credential returns denied
the configured operator resolves the exact durable ticket
the real staged file appears before cancellation and survives reopen
cancellation persists and the resumed turn cannot report false completion
the native process is cleaned up after the public protocol completes

evidence.artifact_binding: Record the exact native executable digest and qualified source commit/tree.
evidence.declined_effect: The deterministic Rust fixture test covers declined approval and confirms no staged file; this installed driver covers approved effect and recovery.
evidence.fixture_boundary: This scenario proves Harness admission, durable operator authorization, real local staging, cancellation, and recovery with a deterministic provider; it does not prove production model quality.
